CustomField.description:
Calculates an overall Enrollment Forms Status based on required document fields.
Complete = all required enrollment documents are verified/accepted or have valid ATS/HLQ/race/ethnicity values.
Started = student is New and at least one required document has been started or related demographic info is present.
Not Started = no progress on required enrollment forms.
CustomField.formula:
IF( TEXT(LearnerAccount.Student_Type__c) = "Returning", "N/A",
IF( AND( TEXT(Birth_Certificate__c)="V", TEXT(Immunization_Records__c)="V", TEXT(Physical_Upload__c)="V", OR( TEXT(Pre_K_Flu_Shot_Form__c)="Y", TEXT(Pre_K_Flu_Shot_Form__c)="A" ), TEXT(Parent_Contract__c)="V", TEXT(Student_Info_Contact_Form__c)="V", OR( TEXT(Uploaded_IEP__c)="V", TEXT(Uploaded_IEP__c)="A" ), OR( TEXT(MAF_Upload__c)="V", TEXT(MAF_Upload__c)="A" ), TEXT(Housing_Questionnaire__c)="V", CONTAINS(Housing_ATS_Code__c,"("), TEXT(FERPA_Directory_Info_Notice__c)="V", OR( TEXT(Overnight_Trip_Form__c)="V", TEXT(Overnight_Trip_Form__c)="A" ), TEXT(TELA_Fee_Verification__c)="V", OR( TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_1__c)="V", TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_1__c)="A" ), OR( TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_2__c)="V", TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_2__c)="A" ), OR( TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_3__c)="V", TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_3__c)="A" ), TEXT(Home_Language_Questionnaire__c)="V", NOT(ISBLANK(Language_s_on_HLQ__c)), TEXT(Activities_Field_Trip_Consent_Form__c)="V", TEXT(Consent_to_Release_Student_Records__c)="V", TEXT(Computer_Tablet_Use_Consent_Form__c)="V", TEXT(Laptop_Tablet_Agreement__c)="V", TEXT(Ethnic_Identification_Form__c)="V", OR( TEXT(Ethnicity_Answer__c)="H", TEXT(Ethnicity_Answer__c)="N" ), TEXT(Race_Answers__c) <> "N/A, returning student", TEXT(Media_Photo_Release__c)="V" ), "Complete",
IF( AND( TEXT(LearnerAccount.Student_Type__c)="N", OR( TEXT(Birth_Certificate__c)<>"N", TEXT(Immunization_Records__c)<>"N", TEXT(Physical_Upload__c)<>"N", TEXT(Parent_Contract__c)<>"N", TEXT(Student_Info_Contact_Form__c)<>"N", TEXT(Uploaded_IEP__c)<>"unk", TEXT(MAF_Upload__c)<>"unk", TEXT(Housing_Questionnaire__c)<>"N", CONTAINS(Housing_ATS_Code__c,"("), TEXT(FERPA_Directory_Info_Notice__c)<>"N", AND(TEXT(Overnight_Trip_Form__c)<>"yet", TEXT(Overnight_Trip_Form__c)<>"/"), TEXT(TELA_Fee_Verification__c)<>"N", TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_1__c)<>"yet", TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_2__c)<>"yet", TEXT(Proof_of_NYS_Residency_3__c)<>"yet", TEXT(Home_Language_Questionnaire__c)<>"N", NOT(ISBLANK(Language_s_on_HLQ__c)), TEXT(Activities_Field_Trip_Consent_Form__c)<>"N", TEXT(Consent_to_Release_Student_Records__c)<>"N", TEXT(Computer_Tablet_Use_Consent_Form__c)<>"N", TEXT(Laptop_Tablet_Agreement__c)<>"N", TEXT(TELA_Fee_Form__c)<>"N", TEXT(Ethnic_Identification_Form__c)<>"N", TEXT(Race_Answers__c) <> "N/A, returning student", OR( TEXT(Ethnicity_Answer__c)="H", TEXT(Ethnicity_Answer__c)="N" ), TEXT(Media_Photo_Release__c)<>"N" ) ), "Started", "Not Started" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Enrollment Forms Status
